title: Bifibrant simplicial nerves present coherent model localizations
statement:
Use the universe, space and infinity-category conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid] and the simplicial sets of [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]. A model category here is complete and cocomplete, with retract-closed classes $C,F,W$, two-out-of-three for $W$, and functorial weak factorization systems $(C,F\cap W)$ and $(C\cap W,F)$. A weak factorization system means factorization of every arrow and mutually characterized left and right diagonal-lifting classes. Cofibrant and fibrant mean that the initial and terminal maps lie in $C$ and $F$, respectively. A simplicial model category is enriched, tensored and cotensored over Kan-model simplicial sets, with the induced mapping-space map for a cofibration and a fibration a Kan fibration, trivial if either input arrow is also a weak equivalence.

Let $\mathcal M$ be such a simplicial model category and let $\mathcal M^{cf}$ be its full simplicial subcategory of cofibrant fibrant objects. For a simplicial category $\mathcal C$, $N_{\mathrm{hc}}\mathcal C$ denotes its homotopy coherent nerve: its $n$-simplices are simplicial functors from the simplicial thickening of $[n]$ to $\mathcal C$. The thickening has objects $0,\ldots,n$ and mapping simplicial sets the ordinary nerves of the posets of subsets of $[i,j]$ containing both endpoints; composition is union, and the mapping set is empty for $i>j$. Then $N_{\mathrm{hc}}(\mathcal M^{cf})$ is an infinity category and there is an equivalence
$$N(\mathcal M)[W^{-1}]_\infty\simeq N_{\mathrm{hc}}(\mathcal M^{cf})$$
whose inverse agrees on bifibrant objects with their inclusion into $\mathcal M$ followed by localization. The left side is universal at the level of entire functor infinity categories: for every infinity category $\mathcal E$, restriction identifies $\operatorname{Fun}(N(\mathcal M)[W^{-1}]_\infty,\mathcal E)$ with the full subcategory of $\operatorname{Fun}(N(\mathcal M),\mathcal E)$ on functors inverting $W$. Inclusions of the ordinary full subcategories of cofibrant, fibrant or bifibrant objects induce equivalences of their infinity localizations with this localization. For cofibrant $X$ and fibrant $Y$, the enriched simplicial mapping set $\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_{\mathcal M}(X,Y)$ represents $\operatorname{Map}(qX,qY)$ naturally in the localized variables, and this comparison respects compositions wherever the enriched compositions are defined. In particular, for functorial replacements $QX\to X$ and $Y\to RY$, derived mapping spaces are represented by $\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_{\mathcal M}(QX,RY)$. The nerve of the simplicial category of small Kan complexes with their simplicial mapping sets is the resulting model of the infinity category $\mathcal S$ of small spaces.
